data.standardized_narrative: The syndicate experienced a gross release of GBP 4.570 million in prior year claims provisions for the 2014 and prior years of account. This release, representing 5.89% of opening gross reserves, indicates favorable claims development. While the loss experience was impacted by US hurricane events Harvey and Irma in the 2015 and 2016 years of account, estimates remained within reinsurance retention and below initial expectations, contributing to the overall favorable movement.
